document.name: Tutu School DUMBO
document.shortDescription: Story-driven ballet classes in DUMBO for children ages 6 months to 8 years, with weekday and weekend options.
document.longDescription:
Tutu School DUMBO offers storybook-inspired ballet classes for children from infancy through age 8 at 100 Jay Street in Brooklyn. The official site lists Baby Ballet for ages 6 to 18 months, Tutu Toddlers for 18 months to 3 years, Exploring Ballet for ages 3 to 5, and Primary Ballet Prep for ages 5 to 8.

The official classes page publishes recurring examples that span weekday and weekend programming, including Monday morning, afternoon, after-school, and evening classes plus Saturday and Sunday classes. Examples on the official schedule include Monday 9:30 AM Tutu Toddlers, Monday 3:30 PM Exploring Ballet, Monday 5:30 PM Exploring Ballet, Saturday 8:30 AM Tutu Toddlers, Saturday 12:30 PM Primary Ballet Prep, and Sunday 10:30 AM Tutu Toddlers.

The official site lists phone 718.709.0408 for the DUMBO studio.

Sources: https://tutuschool.com/dumbo/ https://tutuschool.com/dumbo/classes/ https://tutuschool.com/dumbo/wp-content/uploads/sites/43/2025/04/TutuSchool-HomeHero-14.jpg
